confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback pypdf extraction, rendered methods/figure pages, Nature HTML, local DOCX supplement, extracted supplement text, and cited-protocol lineage were reviewed. The paper reports synthetic rough and non-rough sound synthesis, Max/MSP Spat rendering, LISTEN HRTFs, rear-left trajectory geometry, duration, speed, SOAs, baseline-like silent timings, randomization, response scoring window, repetitions, catch count, blocks, and total trials. Remaining uncertainty is mainly exact Max/MSP patch settings and catch sound-type split.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The study is recreatable as a rear-left binaural looming PPS profile with two synthetic sound types crossed with seven tactile timings. It is a trunk-centered task even though the tactile actuator is on the left index finger, because hands were held on the trunk midline. Exact Spat room/render settings and author audio files are not supplied.

source_checks.scope: Reviewed methods, stimuli, apparatus, PPS experiment, Fig. 1, statistical analysis, and results for Segment 1-4 parameters.
Used as primary extraction map for stimulus synthesis, HRTF rendering, timing, trial rows, counts, and analysis-window fields.
Searched all 11 PDF pages for stimulus, sound, rough, HRTF, Spat, trajectory, delay, catch, repetition, block, response, baseline, and supplement terms.
Temporary rendered pages were visually checked to verify sound synthesis text, rear-left 135-degree geometry, 5 m approach schematic, timing labels, and count continuation.
Supplement and extracted text were checked for hidden stimulus or count details; it adds RT tables and expectancy correction but no missing Spat patch or catch split.
Nature HTML was checked for open-access status, Methods text, supplement route, and cited prior-protocol papers.

review_attempts.result: Mapped the methods sections containing synthetic sound formulae, Spat/HRTF rendering, trajectory geometry, tactile timing rows, and trial counts.
Confirmed 20 repetitions for each of 14 delay-by-sound conditions, 280 tactile-target trials, 40 catch trials, and 10 blocks of 32 trials.
Verified from Fig. 1 that the virtual source approaches from rear-left space at 135 degrees toward the seated participant rather than from the front.
Checked the DOCX supplement and extracted text; no additional stimulus-generation files or hidden count splits were present.
Separated the two synthetic sound types from the single shared rear-left looming trajectory and recorded the renderer/HRTF provenance.

review_attempts.strategy: Timing, baseline, catch, and count pass
review_attempts.result: Separated T1-T5 sound-period tactile timings from Tbefore/Tafter silent-period baseline-like timings and auditory-only catches.
Recorded the modified Canzoneri task and earlier Taffou/Hobeika rear/lateral PPS methods as lineage; the 2021 paper still reports its own roughness implementation.

stimulus_type.value: Two synthetic 3000 ms sounds at 44.1 kHz: a harmonic non-rough sound with 500 Hz fundamental and seven harmonics, and the same sound amplitude-modulated at 70 Hz to create roughness.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: Sound classes and roughness manipulation are directly reported.

source_provenance.value: Synthetic sounds were generated from the reported harmonic formula; roughness used modulation depth m = 1 at 70 Hz. Exact audio files or Max/MSP patches are not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Formula-level provenance is reported, but not reusable source files.

trajectory_count.value: One shared rear-left looming trajectory crossed with two sound types: non-rough harmonic and rough amplitude-modulated harmonic.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Sound type varies, while spatial trajectory is the same for both sounds.

trajectory_path.value: Virtual sound source approached from the rear-left hemifield at 135 degrees, from 520 cm to 20 cm from the center of the participant's head.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Text and rendered Fig. 1 confirm rear-left rather than frontal movement.

stimulus_duration.value: Each auditory stimulus lasted 3000 ms, preceded by 1000 ms silence and followed by 2700-3300 ms of silence.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Sound duration and silence windows are directly reported.

stimulus_speed.value: The simulated source moved at 166.67 cm/s over the 520 cm to 20 cm rear-left approach.

auditory_conditions.value: The main PPS task crossed two sound types, rough and non-rough, with the same rear-left looming trajectory; emotional and roughness rating tasks were separate.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Roughness is the systematic auditory manipulation in the PPS task.

gain_envelope.value: The two sounds were loudness-equalized using Moore et al.'s model; a 0.8 dB rough/non-rough difference was found. Separate rating-task levels were 76.5 and 77.3 dBA.
gain_envelope.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, Stimuli and emotional evaluation task
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Loudness equalization is reported, but exact Spat gain/path settings are not.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Max/MSP 6.1.8 with Spat rendered direct sound, reflections through order 3, late reverberation, LISTEN non-individual HRTFs, and nearfield correction; playback used DT770 headphones.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Software, HRTF database, rendering components, and headphones are reported.

trial_rows_families.value: The PPS task had tactile-target trials at seven delay levels crossed with two sound types plus auditory-only catch trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The delay-by-sound design and catch family are reported.

condition_intermixing.value: The 14 tactile-target conditions were presented in random order and randomly intermingled with catch trials.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Trials were divided into 10 blocks of 32 trials; within the experiment, trial conditions were randomized rather than blocked by sound type or delay.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Block count and random order are reported.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Each trial had 1000 ms pre-sound silence and 2700-3300 ms post-sound silence; no separate inter-trial interval distribution is reported.
iti_jitter_policy.page_or_section: PDF p.3, Measure of PPS and Fig. 1
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The variable post-sound silence is the reported timing jitter.

response_window.value: Participants responded as quickly as possible by keypress; RTs shorter than 100 ms or exceeding 1000 ms were removed from analyses.
response_window.evidence_note: A scoring/exclusion window is reported, but no separate trial timeout is given.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants were blindfolded, ignored the auditory stimuli, pressed a keypad to detected tactile stimuli, and withheld responses during auditory-only catch trials.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Instruction, response, and catch rules are reported.

tactile_stimulus.value: A 28 mm Veco miniature loudspeaker delivered a 20 ms 250 Hz sinusoidal vibration on the palmar surface of the participant's left index finger.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Tactile device, site, waveform, duration, and frequency are reported.

soa_table.value: Reported timings were Tbefore -650 ms, T1 0 ms, T2 750 ms, T3 1500 ms, T4 2250 ms, T5 3000 ms, and Tafter 3650 ms; T1-T5 imply 520, 395, 270, 145, and 20 cm.
soa_table.page_or_section: PDF pp.3-4, Fig. 1 and Measure of PPS
soa_table.evidence_note: SOAs are reported; distance table is derived from reported speed/path.

baseline_strategy.value: Tbefore and Tafter were silent-period tactile timings used as unimodal baseline-like conditions and for expectancy-effect correction.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Main text and supplement describe silent-period baseline/expectancy logic.

baseline_timing.value: Baseline-like tactile timings were -650 ms before sound onset and +650 ms after sound offset, i.e. 3650 ms from sound onset.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Tbefore and Tafter values are directly reported.

catch_trial_type.value: Catch trials had auditory stimulation only and no tactile target; participants were to withhold responses.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: There were 20 repetitions for each of 14 tactile-target conditions: seven delays crossed with rough versus non-rough sound type.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The repetition formula is directly reported.

baseline_count.value: Baseline-like silent-period tactile count was 80 trials: 20 repetitions x 2 sound types x 2 timings, Tbefore and Tafter.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Count is derived from the reported 14-condition repetition formula.

catch_count.value: There were 40 auditory-only catch trials, randomly intermingled with tactile-target trials.
catch_count.evidence_note: Total catch count is reported; rough/non-rough catch split is not.

block_count.value: The test was divided into 10 blocks of 32 trials, each lasting about 4 min, after a small training block.
block_count.evidence_note: Block count and block size are directly reported.

total_trial_count.value: The PPS test had 320 trials total: 280 tactile-target trials plus 40 auditory-only catch trials.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Total is supported by reported target/catch counts and 10 x 32 blocks.

critical_caveats: Exact Max/MSP/Spat patch, room parameters, and gain automation files are not supplied.
Exact generated WAV files and random seed/source code are not supplied.
PPS playback SPL for the spatialized looming task is not separately reported; only relative loudness equalization and non-spatialized rating-task dBA values are given.
Catch trials are reported only as 40 auditory-only trials; their rough/non-rough split is not explicitly stated.
The trajectory is rear-left at 135 degrees in a binaural virtual-source frame, not a frontal speaker profile.
The task is trunk-centered by posture despite tactile stimulation being delivered to the left index finger.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence rear-left binaural roughness PPS profile. Lab recreation should implement the synthetic sounds from the reported formula and approximate Spat/LISTEN/nearfield rendering with documented renderer defaults unless author patches become available.
